title: Auto-update: an accepted update ships through its own pull request, and uncommitted orion files are offered for shipping
seam: orion.sh check (update offer, auto, uncommitted-files check), skills/orion/, tests/run.sh check section, README.md updates paragraphs, docs/guide/index.html Updates tile, docs/runbook.md
story: Saying yes to an orion update, or turning on auto, no longer leaves changed files in the project folder to commit by hand: the agent updates orion in its own worktree, runs the project's checks, merges once they are green and brings the folder up to date. Orion files left uncommitted, a first install included, are offered for shipping the same way at each session start and are never thrown away; a stale finished update branch is cleaned away instead of blocking the next ship.

checks.do: Install orion into a new empty git folder demo-app with --update-mode auto and commit everything; change line 1 of .claude/orion/VERSION to forty zeros; start a Claude Code session there.
checks.expect: The session asks the agent to ship the update through its own pull request on branch feat/orion-update-v<new>, while git status shows only the VERSION edit.

checks.do: In the committed demo-app, start a session and confirm nothing is said about uncommitted files; add the line '# note' to .claude/skills/issue-map/scripts/issue_map.py and start a new session.
checks.expect: A question whether to ship orion's files through their own pull request (Ship them / Not now); the '# note' line is still in the file afterwards.

checks.do: Open the README section on keeping orion up to date and the guide's Updates tile.
checks.expect: Both say an agent ships the update through its own pull request, and that uncommitted orion files are offered for shipping, never thrown away.

checks.do: git init an empty folder demo-app, install orion there without committing, start two sessions and say Ship them when asked.
checks.expect: A pull request titled chore(orion): install orion <version> that includes .claude/settings.json, .claude/orion/config.json and CLAUDE.md; the agent stops there and says a person merges it.

checks.do: In demo-app, let a first install ship and merge its pull request by hand; add '# note' to .claude/skills/issue-map/scripts/issue_map.py; start a session and say Ship them.
checks.expect: The old feat/orion-update-v<X> worktree and branch are removed and a new pull request carrying the edit is opened; the offer does not return after it merges.
